description: Climate Inspector is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by National Center for Atmospheric Research | GIS Program | Climate Change Scenarios GIS Data Portal. Explore maps showing projected changes in temperature or precipitation for any location on the globe for four different emissions trajectories. Results are from the CMIP5 global modeling experiment. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
